questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electric Charges & Fields. two point charges are separated by distance r. If the separation is doubled, the electrostatic force becomes:
questions.explanation: Coulomb force varies inversely as the square of separation.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electric Charges & Fields. the SI unit of electric flux is:
questions.explanation: Electric flux is E·A, giving N m² C⁻¹.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electrostatic Potential & Capacitance. the potential difference between two points is 12 V. Work done in moving 2 C between them is:

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electrostatic Potential & Capacitance. a parallel-plate capacitor is completely filled with a dielectric of constant K. Its capacitance becomes:
questions.explanation: The dielectric increases capacitance by the factor K.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Current Electricity. a wire's resistance is doubled while its potential difference remains constant. The current becomes:
questions.explanation: Ohm's law gives I=V/R; doubling R halves I.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Current Electricity. the drift speed of electrons in a metallic conductor is directly proportional to:
questions.explanation: For a given material, drift velocity is proportional to the applied electric field.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Moving Charges & Magnetism. a charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field parallel to the field. The magnetic force is:
questions.explanation: F=qvB sinθ; for θ=0°, force is zero.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Moving Charges & Magnetism. the SI unit of magnetic field is:
questions.explanation: Magnetic flux density is measured in tesla.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Magnetism & Matter. a material weakly repelled by a magnetic field is:
questions.explanation: Diamagnetic substances develop magnetisation opposing the applied field.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electromagnetic Induction. lenz's law is a consequence of conservation of:
questions.explanation: The induced current opposes the change producing it, consistent with energy conservation.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Alternating Current. the rms value of a sinusoidal current with peak value I₀ is:

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Electromagnetic Waves. which electromagnetic radiation has the highest frequency?
questions.explanation: Gamma rays occupy the highest-frequency region of the electromagnetic spectrum.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Ray Optics. the power of a converging lens of focal length 0.5 m is:
questions.explanation: P=1/f with f in metres, so P=+2 dioptres.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Wave Optics. in Young's double-slit experiment, fringe width increases when:
questions.explanation: β=λD/d; increasing D increases fringe width.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Semiconductor Electronics. a p-n junction diode conducts readily when it is:
questions.explanation: Forward bias reduces the depletion barrier and permits significant current.
